facts.business: Tube Investments of India Limited is a diversified conglomerate with operations in engineering, metal formed products, mobility, and industrial solutions through its subsidiaries including CG Power and Industrial Solutions, Shanthi Gears, TI Medical, and others.
key_risks: Geopolitical conflicts and trade restrictions impacting global supply chains
Higher tariffs and retaliatory measures including restriction on export of rare earth materials
Volatility in crude oil prices increasing inflation risks
Sensitivity of goodwill impairment projections to assumptions relating to gross margin, discount rate and growth rate
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with the related parties are in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 where applicable and the details have been disclosed in the notes to the Standalone Financial Statements, as required by the applicable accounting standards.
